processor: Helios trapped-ion QCCD + Microsoft qubit-virtualization (Knill / tesseract color codes)
notes: PUBLICATION MILESTONE (peer-reviewed in Nature 2026-06-10), not a new experimental demonstration -- results first appeared in an April-2024 preprint. Up to 12 parallelized logical qubits demonstrated; 4 via a 16-qubit 4D tesseract color code [[16,4,?]], 2 via a 12-qubit Knill-inspired [[12,2,?]] code, on the Quantinuum Helios platform (98 Ba ions, already on record as HW-061-family). Headline metric: logical error rate up to 800x lower than physical baseline (Bell-state physical 0.8% -> logical 0.001%); 51x suppression per correction round; 22x for 12-qubit GHZ/cat prep; range 11x-800x across circuit types. RELEVANCE 2-3/5: validates Quantinuum as a high-fidelity QEC platform but 12 logical qubits in these codes is below our 16q transport target; the catalogued Helios 48-logical spec is what matters for us. First journal-validated result of this 800x magnitude on real hardware. Distinct from the preprint milestone. Discovered_by hardware-tracker 2026-06-16.
